Class Fp8BlockDequant

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.quant.Fp8BlockDequant
public final class Fp8BlockDequant extends Object
Dequantizes DeepSeek / Qwen-style fine-grained FP8 weights (weight_block_size = [128, 128] + weight_scale_inv).

Official Qwen3.8-FP8 checkpoints use block scales; Fp8BlockLinear runs them via at::_scaled_mm_v2. This helper dequantizes for reference tests and debug only.
